title.en: ABERRANT ↔ 讹 é · 反常的／偏离常规的
title.zh-Hans: ABERRANT ↔ 讹 é · 反常的／偏离常规的

languages.name: Latin
languages.pronunciation: [ɛrˈraː.rɛ] approximate Classical reference; not recorded ancient speech

gloss.en: Departing from an accepted standard, normal course or natural type; atypical
gloss.zh-Hans: 偏离公认标准、正常路径或通常类型的；反常的、异常的

meaning.en: Standard adjective meaning: departing from the usual or normal type. Featured err ↔ 讹 é belongs to the related ERROR stage; modern semantic mapping → 偏; earlier Latin WANDER/STRAY mapping pending.
meaning.zh-Hans: 标准形容词义：反常的／偏离常规的。特色 err ↔ 讹 é 属于词族的 ERROR 阶段；现代语义映射 → 偏；早期拉丁 WANDER／STRAY 阶段待定。

rationale.en: The standard adjective translation describes deviation from a norm. The featured err ↔ 讹 comparison is limited to the related ERROR stage, with separate evidence and confidence.
rationale.zh-Hans: 标准形容词翻译描述偏离常态；特色 err ↔ 讹 比较限定在相关 ERROR 阶段，证据与置信度独立。

summary.en: English aberrant comes from Latin aberrant-, aberrans, the present participle of aberrare: ab- ‘away, from’ + errare ‘wander, stray, be mistaken’. French aberrant/aberrante is the adjectivized present participle of French aberrer, itself borrowed from Latin aberrare; it is not evidenced here as an English loan. French erreur continues Latin error, erroris.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 aberrant 来自拉丁语 aberrant-、aberrans，即 aberrare 的现在分词：ab-“离开、从” + errare“游荡、偏离、犯错”。法语 aberrant／aberrante 是法语 aberrer 的形容词化现在分词，而 aberrer 借自拉丁语 aberrare；没有证据支持它从英语借入。法语 erreur 承自拉丁语 error、erroris。

claim.en: English aberrant is chiefly an adjective borrowed from Latin aberrant-, aberrans, present participle of aberrare.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 aberrant 主要是形容词，借自拉丁语 aberrant-、aberrans，即 aberrare 的现在分词。

claim.en: Latin aberrare is morphologically ab- ‘away/from’ + errare ‘wander, stray, err’; the b belongs to the inherited prefix ab-.
claim.zh-Hans: 拉丁语 aberrare 的形态是 ab-“离开／从” + errare“游荡、偏离、犯错”；b 属于继承的前缀 ab-。

claim.en: French aberrant/aberrante is an adjectivized present participle of aberrer; French aberrer was borrowed from Latin aberrare.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 aberrant／aberrante 是 aberrer 的形容词化现在分词；法语 aberrer 借自拉丁语 aberrare。

claim.en: English err is a verb from Middle English erren, borrowed from Anglo-French and Latin errare; French erreur is a feminine noun from Latin error, erroris.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 err 是动词，来自中古英语 erren，经盎格鲁-法语和拉丁语 errare；法语 erreur 是阴性名词，来自拉丁语 error、erroris。

summary.en: Featured ERR / ERROR ↔ 讹 é: error semantics overlap, but err is a verb; 讹 is selected in error/corruption uses. BrE non-rhotic /ɜː/, rhotic /er, ɝ/ and Mandarin /ɤ˧˥/ differ. Modern stage → 偏; Latin wander/stray stage mapping pending.
summary.zh-Hans: 特色 ERR / ERROR ↔ 讹 é：错误义有交集，但 err 为动词，讹取差错／讹误用法。非 rhotic 英式 /ɜː/、rhotic /er, ɝ/ 与普通话 /ɤ˧˥/ 不同。现代阶段 → 偏；拉丁游走／迷途阶段 Mapping pending。

claim.en: Featured 讹 é compares the ERR / ERROR family error sense, using modern English err for the sound test. It is not a translation of the whole adjective aberrant or a reconstruction of Latin pronunciation. Historical Relation: Not claimed.
claim.zh-Hans: 特色讹 é 对应 ERR / ERROR 词族的错误义阶段，声音检验采用现代英语 err。它不是整个形容词 aberrant 的标准翻译，也不是拉丁古音重构。Historical Relation: Not claimed。

summary.en: Modern ABERRANT → 偏 is a semantic abstraction. Latin WANDER / STRAY and figurative ERROR coexist in the recorded family: the path is a semantic organization, not a dated sequence in which each sense replaced the previous one.
summary.zh-Hans: 现代 ABERRANT → 偏 是语义概括。拉丁词族已有游走／偏离及比喻错误义并存；此路径为语义组织，不是每义依次取代前义的精确年代链。

summary.en: The proposed idea that b was inserted merely to connect initial a to err is rejected as a historical explanation: b is part of Latin ab-. The observation is preserved as an author sound-structure hypothesis, not deleted.
summary.zh-Hans: “b 只是为连接开头 a 与 err 而加入”的想法，作为历史解释被否定：b 属于拉丁前缀 ab-。这一观察仍作为作者的声音结构假说保留，而非删除。

claim.en: Author hypothesis: b may have been inserted between a and err as a consonantal bridge.
claim.zh-Hans: 作者假说：b 可能作为辅音桥梁插入 a 与 err 之间。

claim.en: err ↔ 讹 is an accent-dependent partial resemblance, not homophony.
claim.zh-Hans: err ↔ 讹 为受口音影响的部分音近，不是同音。

phonetic_observation.scope: Modern English sound comparison within a historically identified family; no Latin–Old Chinese sound equation

onset.en: Both are phonologically vowel-initial. Absence of an onset is common and not positive evidence of a consonant correspondence.
onset.zh-Hans: 均可分析为零声母／元音起首；无声母很常见，不是辅音规律对应的正证。

vowel.en: BrE /ɜː/ is a long central vowel; AmE /er/ has a front vowel and /r/, or /ɝ/ has rhotic colouring. Mandarin /ɤ/ is back and unrounded; spelling e does not equate these vowels.
vowel.zh-Hans: 英式 /ɜː/ 为长央元音；美式 /er/ 为前元音加 /r/，另有卷舌 /ɝ/。普通话 /ɤ/ 为后不圆唇元音；字母 e 相似不等于元音相同。

rhoticity.en: Non-rhotic BrE err has no final /r/ before a pause, but may link /r/ before a vowel; rhotic accents retain /r/ or r-colouring. Mandarin é has neither.
rhoticity.zh-Hans: 非 rhotic 英式 err 在停顿前无词尾 /r/，元音前可连读 /r/；rhotic 口音保留 /r/ 或卷舌色彩；普通话 é 均无。

syllables.en: err and é are monosyllabic. error is two syllables /ˈerə(r), ˈerər/; erreur /ɛ.ʁœʁ/ is two syllables with uvular rhotics and a rounded /œ/. Neither is a homophone of é; whole aberrant has three syllables.
syllables.zh-Hans: err、é 均单音节；error /ˈerə(r), ˈerər/ 为两音节；erreur /ɛ.ʁœʁ/ 为两音节，含小舌音及圆唇 /œ/。两者均非 é 的同音词；完整 aberrant 为三音节。

tone.en: Mandarin é has lexical rising tone /ɤ˧˥/; English stress and French phrase prosody do not match Mandarin tone.
tone.zh-Hans: 普通话 é 带阳平 /ɤ˧˥/；英语重音、法语短语韵律不对应普通话词汇声调。

rating.method: Editorial components: onset absence 1/10; vowel resemblance 4/8; rhotic/coda fit across accents 2/5; one-syllable shape 3/4; tone/prosody 0/3. No acoustic data. The whole error/erreur words receive no transferred err score.

limitations.en: Featured 讹 é compares the ERR / ERROR family error sense, using modern English err for the sound test. It is not a translation of the whole adjective aberrant or a reconstruction of Latin pronunciation. Historical Relation: Not claimed.
limitations.zh-Hans: 特色讹 é 对应 ERR / ERROR 词族的错误义阶段，声音检验采用现代英语 err。它不是整个形容词 aberrant 的标准翻译，也不是拉丁古音重构。Historical Relation: Not claimed。

claim.en: English err and Mandarin 讹 é may form a memorable modern sound-meaning association in the ERROR/DEVIATION field, without common-origin claim.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 err 与普通话“讹”é 可能在 ERROR／DEVIATION 语义场形成可记忆的现代声音—意义联想，但不主张共同来源。

supporting_cases: err: verb, make a mistake; earlier stray
one LATIN-ERRARE family, not independent English/French samples

testability.en: Test blinded sound-similarity and semantic-relatedness separately, with unrelated onsetless-vowel controls and multiple English accents.
testability.zh-Hans: 分别盲测声音相似度与语义相关度，加入无关零声母元音负对照，并覆盖多种英语口音。

claim.en: The b in aberrant was added as a consonantal bridge between a and err.
claim.zh-Hans: aberrant 中的 b 是在 a 与 err 之间加入的辅音桥。

supporting_cases: surface segmentation a.b.err.ant in the author note
counterexamples: French aberrer independently continues Latin aberrare

testability.en: Historical morphology is already testable against attested Latin forms and dictionary etymologies; those sources contradict the insertion account.
testability.zh-Hans: 历史形态可直接用有文献的拉丁语形式与词源词典检验；这些来源与插入说相矛盾。

proposition.en: In a moment of error, is it beauty like a swan’s, or a goose’s mistaken call? No, that love is full of beauty and art.
proposition.zh-Hans: 错讹的时候，是一种如天鹅般美丽还是家鹅的讹音？不，那爱充满美艺。

translations.text: In a moment of error, is it beauty like a swan’s, or a goose’s mistaken call? No, that love is full of beauty and art.

evidence_boundary.en: The swan/domestic-goose, mis-sound, love, beauty and art wordplay is literature. It does not support the historical morphology or the err ↔ 讹 hypothesis.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 天鹅／家鹅、讹音、爱、美与艺的文字游戏属于文学，不为历史形态或 err ↔ 讹假说提供证据。

source.raw_note: 英语：aberrant n. 错误；a.b.err.ant；这里也许是 err 前面与元音 a 相连需要加一个辅音。err n. 错误。法语：aberrant a. 荒谬；a.b.err.ant；这个词从英语而来；aberrant (masculine)，aberrante (feminine)；erreur n. 错误。汉语：讹【e】n. 谣言，错误。备注：这里 aberrant，是 err 前面与元音 a 相连需要加一个辅音。诗文：错讹的时候，是一种如天鹅般美丽还是家鹅的讹音？不，那爱充满美艺。When it is aberrant, is it a kind of beautiful like a swan or a mispronunciation of a goose? No, that love is full of beauty and art.

features.vowel: BrE /ɜː/ is a long central vowel; AmE /er/ has a front vowel and /r/, or /ɝ/ has rhotic colouring. Mandarin /ɤ/ is back and unrounded; spelling e does not equate these vowels.
features.coda_other_consonants: Non-rhotic BrE err has no final /r/ before a pause, but may link /r/ before a vowel; rhotic accents retain /r/ or r-colouring. Mandarin é has neither.
features.syllables: err and é are monosyllabic. error is two syllables /ˈerə(r), ˈerər/; erreur /ɛ.ʁœʁ/ is two syllables with uvular rhotics and a rounded /œ/. Neither is a homophone of é; whole aberrant has three syllables.
features.prosody: Mandarin é has lexical rising tone /ɤ˧˥/; English stress and French phrase prosody do not match Mandarin tone.

diachronic_semantic_mapping.historical_path: English aberrant ← Latin aberrant- / aberrāns (present participle of aberrāre = ab- + errāre). French aberrant ← adjectivized participle of aberrer ← Latin aberrāre. English err ← Middle English erren ← Anglo-French and Latin errāre; error / erreur share the Latin error family. These are branches, not English → French → Latin in a single borrowing chain.
diachronic_semantic_mapping.semantic_path: WANDER / STRAY → DEVIATE FROM A PATH → ERROR / DEPARTURE FROM A NORM (semantic organization; meanings coexist, no dated replacement sequence claimed)

corrections: Not homophones: compare actual accent-specific IPA.
Latin ab- + errāre: b belongs to ab-, away/from; not English intervocalic insertion.
French aberrant is the adjectivized present participle of aberrer, borrowed from Latin aberrāre; English borrowing is not supported.
aberrant mainly adjective, err verb, error noun. MW also records a noun aberrant (one that is aberrant), not the ordinary noun error.

tone.en: Mandarin é has lexical rising tone /ɤ˧˥/; English stress and French phrase prosody do not match Mandarin tone.
